newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 5.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Nov 5:

WASHINGTON - The Securities and Exchange Commission will conduct a review of the mutual fund investment community to look for possible abuses in payments that brokerage firms make to investment advisers.
WASHINGTON - Opponents of MCI Communications Corp.'s merger with British Telecommunications PLC will have an uphill battle.

WASHINGTON - The multibillion dollar merger of BT and MCI will create a new company called Concert PLC and whether that means a new name for the MCI Center sports arena under construction in downtown D.C. is up in the air.
WASHINGTON - Orbital Sciences Corp., the Northern Virginia space company, suffered the third launch failure in two years in its troubled Pegasus rocket program.
